line.en: One sheet folded in 3D, step by step: each fold is marked on the paper in the accent, then made, then rests while it is read.

for.en: Anything made or explained by folding one sheet, one model to a film: origami models step by step, a procedure told as folds, a model opened back to its crease pattern.

not.en: Data-heavy explainers, people or footage, scenes that need many separate objects: everything on screen is one folded sheet. Models finished by opening a pocket (a cup, a boat) stay flat.
